description: Frozen design of the no-skill A/B effectiveness experiment. No control or treatment card has been run and no three-cell verdict exists in this round. Any correction VOIDS this round and requires a NEW freeze id and NEW hashes.

parameters.theta_meaning: sharp null of no pair-level treatment effect
parameters.bh_note: The Benjamini-Hochberg family contains exactly ONE primary test. BH over a single primary test does NOT change the threshold: critical value = (1/1) * 0.05 = 0.05. No multiplicity correction is applied to the primary test.

admissible_evidence_types.note: Exactly 3 admissible types. The pre-C2 draft's 'four evidence types' wrongly included a 4th, prose-only type ('should work' / author assertion), which is NOT admissible and fires E01.

types.name: pasted command output
types.machine_check: fenced real stdout / stderr / PASS lines in the Check section

types.name: machine counts, exit codes and hashes
screenshots and CDP traces
types.machine_check: image artifact or CDP trace referenced

admissible_evidence_types.inadmissible: T4 prose-only claim such as 'should work' (E01 -> FAIL)

grid.note: All FOUR cells are present with n=2 paired cards each. C4 (execution x evidence-not-required) is the cell missing in the pre-C2 v1 design.

cards.prompt: You are an AI project lead. Write a one-page subagent brief for a data-migration task. The brief must declare exact output file paths, an exhaustive FORBIDDEN list, mutually-exclusive file ownership, and an acceptance section that requires pasted verification evidence. Deliver the brief as your answer.

You are improving a skill package. Draft an improvement-plan section that maps three named cold-read findings to concrete remediation tasks, and include a 10-dimension score table with a baseline total, a target total and per-dimension deltas. Deliver the section as your answer.
Summarize, in exactly three sentences for a newcomer, why a PDCA task log is used in AI-led engineering projects. No sources or evidence are required in your answer.
cards.control_seed_defect: The no-skill control arm is expected to answer with prose only (T4), so a treatment that enforces at least one admissible evidence item should discriminate.

cards.prompt: List four trigger phrases that should open the ai-project-ops skill. Provide only the four phrases, with no justification and no evidence.
cards.control_seed_defect: The no-skill control arm is expected to answer with prose only (T4), so a treatment that enforces at least one admissible evidence item should discriminate.

cards.prompt: Run the package self-check suite and report the result. Your answer must contain the pasted PASS lines and the process exit code, and must assert that the exit code is 0 and that there are zero JS exceptions.
Compute the SHA-256 of two frozen documents and report the result. Your answer must paste the sha256sum output lines and state whether the digests match the values recorded in the freeze manifest.
Start the local panel server for the linked-gantt-board asset and report that it is up. No verification output is required in your answer.
cards.control_seed_defect: The no-skill control arm is expected to claim success with prose only (T4) and no process evidence, so a treatment that attaches a real health check should discriminate. This is the cell missing in the pre-C2 v1 design.

cards.prompt: Copy the command snapshot to the system clipboard and report that the copy is done. No verification output is required in your answer.
cards.control_seed_defect: The no-skill control arm is expected to claim success with prose only (T4) and no clipboard read-back, so a treatment that attaches a real read-back should discriminate.

blinding.method: Cards carry neutral blind_label values only. Control and treatment arm identity, and the arm-to-pair mapping, are sealed in a blind key held outside the package by the main session. No card filename, label, metadata or prompt reveals the arm.
blinding.effect: Any exposure of arm identity before scoring is a veto -> FAIL + round VOID.

primary.name: paired verifiable-outcome difference
primary.definition: For each of the 8 paired cards, the difference (treatment minus control) in whether the produced Check section contains at least one admissible evidence item (T1/T2/T3).
primary.statistic: exact randomization / sign test over 2^8 = 256 assignments

secondary_exploratory: per-cell mean paired difference (4 cells, n=2 each)
per-cell discrimination including the failure cells (E10)
leave-one-out stability of the exact p-value (8 recomputations)
estimands.note: Only the primary estimand drives the three-cell verdict. Secondary estimands are exploratory, are outside the BH family, and can never change the verdict.

decision_rule.precedence_note: Highest first; the first rule that fires wins. Matches references/pdca-three-state.md.
decision_rule.gain_note: A gain whose corrected exact p > 0.05 is UNCERTAIN, NEVER PASS.

bh_family.note: ONE primary test. BH over a single primary test does NOT change the threshold: (1/1)*0.05 = 0.05.

rules.label: FAIL
rules.condition: Any veto fired: E07 (frozen artifact changed) or E08 (unblinding detected).
rules.note: Veto overrides ANY positive primary result, including a 30/30 PASS.

rules.label: UNCERTAIN
rules.condition: Evidence incomplete or unverifiable: E12 (Chrome unavailable), E02 (meter schema mismatch), E10 (no discrimination in a failure cell), underpowered, OR a gain with corrected exact p > 0.05.
rules.note: UNCERTAIN wins over FAIL when evidence is incomplete.

rules.label: FAIL
rules.condition: A performed check returned negative, or Check evidence is absent (E01, E03, E04, E05, E06, E09, E11). Evidence is complete.
rules.note: FAIL for a produced negative result.

rules.label: PASS
rules.condition: A/B comparison present, corrected exact p <= 0.05, all four 2x2 cells have n=2, all four evidence layers green, no veto, and real evidence pasted.
rules.note: PASS is the LAST rule, not the default. It requires both an A/B comparison and a p-value.

self_check.note: Exactly 4 self-check cases, defined identically in docs/IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md (Section 11), docs/EFFECTIVENESS-EXPERIMENT-DESIGN.md (Section 7) and here. Every case maps to an explicit three-cell label. No case expects PASS without an A/B comparison and a p-value.

cases.scenario: Full valid round: 8 paired cards, A/B comparison present, corrected exact p = 0.00390625 <= 0.05, all 4 cells n=2, no veto, all 4 evidence layers green, evidence pasted.
cases.why: PASS requires an A/B comparison and a p-value; both are present. This fixes the v1 case 1 that expected PASS with no A/B and no p.

cases.scenario: A/B comparison complete and significant, but a performed self-check returned a red FAIL line (E09) with Check evidence present; no veto; evidence complete.
cases.why: A produced negative result is FAIL; evidence is complete, so UNCERTAIN does not apply.

cases.scenario: A/B comparison shows a gain but corrected exact p = 0.0625 > 0.05; one failure cell shows no discrimination (E10). No veto.
cases.why: A gain with corrected p > 0.05 is UNCERTAIN, not PASS.

cases.scenario: A frozen artifact SHA-256 mismatch (E07) or unblinding (E08) is detected while a 30/30 PASS primary result exists.
cases.why: Veto has top precedence and overrides the positive primary result. Three-cell label FAIL, round VOID. This fixes the v1 case 4 that said 'veto fires' without a three-cell label.

failure_cells.definition: 2x2 cells in which the no-skill control arm is deliberately seeded with a known defect, so a measurable control-vs-treatment difference is expected. A failure cell with effect = 0 or per-cell p >= 0.05 fires E10 and resolves the round to UNCERTAIN. Failure cells are discrimination anchors, NOT FAIL verdicts.
failure_cells.note: C2 = specification x evidence-not-required; C4 = execution x evidence-not-required (the cell missing in the pre-C2 v1 design). Each has n=2 paired cards.

veto.effect: FAIL + round VOID; overrides any positive primary result

self_hash.note: This file stores NO hash of itself. Its SHA-256 is recorded in docs/evidence/freeze-manifest.json. A freeze file that changed its own decision rules cannot silently re-certify itself.

hashes_policy: The two document hashes above were computed with sha256sum after both v2 documents were final. The SHA-256 of THIS freeze file is stored in docs/evidence/freeze-manifest.json, never here.
